method: From certain public ZL practice training paragraph words choose the six most frequent lowercase single-glyph EVA letters. Put one on each face of an ordinary fair die. Roll four times independently per word and write the rolled spelling twice. Roll anew for each word. There is no lexicon, ordering rule, shared state or token fitting. Fixed seed 20261128. Each word is eight glyphs. Matched validation includes a two-roll repetition control, distinct length-eight words and equal-length public ZL, IT and RF contrasts.

frozen_plan.training: Take the six most frequent certain single-character lowercase ASCII Basic EVA glyphs on public ZL practice training paragraph lines. Break ties alphabetically. Use the counts only to choose the alphabet, and use each glyph once on an ordinary six-sided die.

methods.primary: Independently roll four dice per word and write the four-face spelling twice. All words have eight displayed glyphs, and joins never insert anything. The independent four-roll choice has at most 1296 outputs and 10.33985 bits before sampling. No text, vocabulary, state, glyph position bias or manuscript word frequencies enter the generation rule after the alphabet is fixed.
methods.lower: Roll twice per word and repeat that pair four times. Eight displayed glyphs and the same one-position marginal as the primary arm, but the support is only 36.
methods.upper: Draw distinct words without replacement from the six-glyph length-eight space. This fixes empirical entropy at log2(N) for every scored prefix.
methods.order_invariance: Shuffle the primary prefix without replacing tokens. All word frequencies and their entropy remain identical.

frozen_plan.scoring: Send the primary seed only with token cut. Apply current installed F-031 advisory to exactly this attack and compare the lower and upper controls on the same public raw token count. Also compute each arm on the certain-token count of public ZL, Takahashi and RF, matching reference length wherever available and logging reference shortages. Do not choose a seed based on results.

public_evidence.equal_reference_length_diagnostic: Added a 4,000-token prefix comparison after the main design was frozen. This threshold is the eligibility floor for every installed reference language. The primary generator and submitted token stream are unchanged.
